inclusionRules.main: All .flix files under main/ in upstream
inclusionRules.examples: All .flix files outside main/ in upstream. Named 'examples' rather than 'test' -- upstream's own test sources live under main/test and are counted in 'main'.

note: Hand-written, not generated. The implementation plan's layout calls for a generated file list with per-file digests; corpus identity currently rests on upstream.treeHash alone, which corpus/fetch verifies. Recorded here so the deviation is visible rather than silent.
